name: Semiconductor Processing Co
old_description: Semiconductor Processing Co. (SPC) shall continue in operation at its present facility in Boston, through 12/31/2012.
about:
Semiconductor Processing Co. (SPC) has operated from Boston, Massachusetts since its founding in 1967. The company occupies a facility at 12 Channel Street in the city's Seaport district, where it has provided precision wafer manufacturing services for over four decades. No information about the founders or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

SPC specializes in the production of Silicon on Insulator (SOI) and Germanium on Insulator (GeOI) wafers, offering substrate bonding services and 200 mm wafer processing. Its equipment lineup includes a production bonder for SOI and direct wafer bonding, a scanning acoustic microscope, an MRL dual horizontal tube furnace, and various ADE gauges for metrology. The company does not publish facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures.

The business serves the semiconductor industry, supplying engineered wafers to device manufacturers and research organizations. The website does not name specific customers or end markets beyond the general wafer manufacturing sector.

The company emphasizes its long track record in precision wafer manufacturing, dating back to 1967, but does not articulate a specific founding mission or competitive differentiation beyond its technical capabilities.
